title: Discord OSINT Assistant: An Open Source Intelligence Gathering Platform
description: A self-hosted Discord bot that exposes 32 slash commands for Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) gathering and analysis. It covers domain analysis, identity investigation, blockchain analysis, transportation intelligence, image metadata extraction, and AI-powered analysis. Designed for investigators, researchers, security professionals, and educational institutions conducting legitimate OSINT research.
notes: This software is designed for legitimate OSINT research, security testing, and educational purposes. Users are responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable laws and ethical guidelines. It runs OSINT workflows through a Discord interface, supporting collaborative investigations and research workflows.
